attributes.title: WSHA 2027 Annual Convention
attributes.organizer: Wisconsin Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology Association
attributes.summary: The Wisconsin Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology Association holds its 2027 Annual Convention on February 4-5, 2027, at the Ingleside Resort in Pewaukee under the theme "Educate, Evolve and Empower: Evidence in Action." The program has audiology, birth-to-6, medical and schools tracks, a Thursday pre-conference and Friday posters. Early-bird rates end December 1, 2026, and CEUs require the online learning assessment.
